The fully paid ordinary shares which have a par value of Kshs 5, carry one vote per share and carry a right to dividends.
The redeemable non cumulative preference shares which have an issue price of Kshs 31.58 do not have any voting rights but
have the same rights to dividends as the ordinary shares. The right to redemption of the redeemable preference shares is at the
discretion of the company hence they have been classified as equity.
Class A ordinary shares reported in 2009 relate to the shares held by the employees of the company which were listed as ordinary
shares on the Nairobi Stock Exchange in July 2010 and therefore the classification no longer applies.
